dcm2niix: interactive BIDS curation: acquisition labels and fieldmap associations are user decisions; upstream dcm2niix supplies the converter command line
surfannotate: interactive surface annotation: every result is a manual choice in the viewer
zarro: interactive OME-Zarr viewer: it has no batch output
nesvor: needs CUDA; its standalone form is the neurodesk-compute server
dicomview: interactive DICOM browser: dcm2niix and dicompare already ship as command lines
pipeline-builder: writes NeuroFlow workflows: neuroflow-mcp runs and validates them from the command line
dwicorrect: exes/dwi/shoreline builds the shoreline command line on the same core; its release packaging follows the app
fastprep: exes/fastprep drives separately installed niimath, brainchop, greedy-rs, synthsr, topofit and glm; a bundled release waits on packaging those (TopoFit licence pending)
me-ica: its meica CLI is released from niivue/meica-rs; no release is tagged yet
ants-denoise: ANTs ships DenoiseImage as its own command line: the Standalone dialog lists the Neurodesk ANTs container, whose DenoiseImage gives the app's voxels with one thread and the same options
brainqcnet: the authors publish BrainQCNet as a BIDS app container: the Standalone dialog lists garciaml/brainqcnetcpu 1.0.1, whose tables the app reproduces byte for byte (packages/brainqcnet/validation)
brainchop: upstream neuroneural/brainchop-core publishes its own native and Python command line (pip install brainchop); no separate Neurodesk command line is packaged
calcium-imaging: no command-line package yet: v1 runs its pipeline (src/core) in browser workers only; CaImAn and Suite2p are the established command-line tools for batch work
gliomoda: the Neurocontainers gliomoda 0.0.4 image is the command-line reference: the Standalone dialog lists it, and packages/gliomoda/validation holds the app's labels to its outputs on the example
neuromorph: NeuroM, whose definitions the app follows, is the command-line route for batch morphometrics (pip install neurom); NeuroMorph has no packaged command line of its own yet
stitching: no command-line package yet: v1 runs its pipeline (src/core) in browser workers only; Fiji's Grid/Collection stitching and BigStitcher are the established command-line tools for batch work
microsam: micro-sam (pip or conda install micro_sam) is the Python reference the app reproduces mask for mask on the example; interactive prompting has no separate command line
microscope-qc: no command-line package yet: v1 runs its numerics (src/core) in a browser worker only; MetroloJ_QC in Fiji is the established desktop tool for batch QC
cryo-em: RELION is the command line: the app sends each step to RELION 5.1.1 in the Neurodesk relion container, run on the user's cluster by the neurodesk-compute server, whose Slurm-capable release follows ADR-0004; the app adds no command line of its own
lightsheet-atlas: the pipeline (apps/lightsheet-atlas/src) already runs in Node for its validation; a packaged command line is future work, and BrainGlobe's brainreg and cellfinder are the native tools for batch work
histo2mri: no command-line package yet: v1 runs its pipeline (src/core) in a browser worker only; its Greedy affine and warp downloads run in the Greedy command line (greedy-rs) for batch reslicing
tumour-report: the pinned dbouget/raidionics-rads:v1.3.2-py39-cpu container is the upstream command-line reference, and packages/tumour-report/validation holds voxel-exact native mask parity to it; a packaged Node CLI can follow via exes/node-cli
totalsegmentator: upstream TotalSegmentator (wasserth/TotalSegmentator) ships the native Python CLI and Neurodesk packages it as totalsegmentator 2.18.0: the Standalone dialog lists the Neurodesk container (Docker and Apptainer), and packages/totalsegmentator/validation/validate.mjs verifies the JS pipeline against upstream reference outputs
medsam2: MedSAM2 (bowang-lab/MedSAM2 in Python) is the upstream reference; interactive slice prompting has no separate command line
brainchomp: browser-only v1 using vendored brainchomp-lib WebGPU/WebGL2/CPU WASM modules; no separate command-line package is released yet
dermoscope: browser-only v1: DullRazor hair removal, Shades of Gray color constancy, Otsu segmentation and ABCD morphometry run in pure JS (apps/dermoscope/src/core) and are Node-tested; no command-line package is released yet
skin-chromophore: browser-only v1: CIELAB, ITA typology, Erythema/Melanin indices, Tsumura chromophore separation and CIEDE2000 run in pure JS (apps/skin-chromophore/src/core) and are Node-tested; no command-line package is released yet
wound-planimetry: browser-only v1: calibrated wound planimetry and RYB tissue classification run in pure JS (apps/wound-planimetry/src/core) with interactive ruler calibration; no command-line package is released yet
derm-compare: browser-only v1: sequential dermoscopy alignment, flicker/curtain comparison and CIEDE2000 change mapping run in pure JS (apps/derm-compare/src/core); no command-line package is released yet
dermvit: browser-only v1: HAM10000 ViT-Base quantized ONNX inference runs via ONNX Runtime Web in a browser worker (apps/dermvit/src/worker.js); no command-line package is released yet
